def build_scanned_count_sentence(packages: List[Package]) ->List[Dict[str, Any]
    ]:
    package_count = len(packages)
    package_text = 'package' if package_count == 1 else 'packages'
    
    return [
        {'style': False, 'value': 'Scanned '},
        {'style': True, 'value': str(package_count)},
        {'style': False, 'value': f' {package_text}'}
    ]
